Reference image is STYLE AND MATERIAL CHARACTER ONLY: study its grey metal floor surfaces. Output a square texture filling the ENTIRE canvas, viewed exactly orthographically from directly above, no perspective, no object outside the texture, NO scene. Neutral UNLIT diffuse color, no reflections, no cast shadows, no orange lighting, no vignette, no baked directional highlights. A real maintained modular steel floor panel about two metres square. Neutral mid-grey, not brown and never almost black. Fine crisp material details appropriate to player-height viewing.
